AegisOps.title: AegisOps — Autonomous AIOps & Self-Healing Kubernetes Control Plane
AegisOps.line1: Locally runnable AIOps control plane and Kubernetes operator that scrubs PII fail-closed (`1.00` precision/recall), maps CMDB blast radius, retrieves runbooks via `pgvector` + Ollama hybrid RAG, and enforces Keycloak OIDC + TOTP MFA approval or deterministic refusal before proving 60s of unbroken recovery.
AegisOps.line2: Verified with **65/65** pytest tests (unit, live K8s/DB integration, Playwright E2E), **240/240** `k6` burst checks (`0.00%` failed), **4/4** live `kind` chaos recoveries + stateful DB refusal, Ruff/Mypy clean across 50 Python modules, and GitHub Actions CI.

polypulse.title: PolyPulse — Cross-Venue Prediction-Market Orderbook & Markout Pipeline
polypulse.line1: Fixed-point C++20 orderbook engine (`std::vector<PriceLevel>`, zero steady-state heap allocations) paired with Python AsyncIO Polymarket/Kalshi/Polygon ingestion, SQLite WAL journaling, ClickHouse `LEFT ASOF JOIN` 5s/30s/60s markout, and official fee-schedule arbitrage scanning.
polypulse.line2: Benchmarked at **56.39M ops/sec** (**17.00 ns** p50) for in-place level updates and **13.53M ops/sec** AVX2 batch VWAP; verified with **133** passing Python tests, C++20 unit assertions, Vite build (`1,578` modules), and GitHub Actions CI.

distributed-flash-sale-engine.title: Distributed Flash-Sale Engine — High-Throughput Ticket Booking Architecture
distributed-flash-sale-engine.line1: High-concurrency ticketing engine eliminating TOCTOU race conditions and overselling via $O(1)$ Redis Lua atomic reservation gates, Redlock distributed locks, two-phase compensating `INCRBY` saga rollbacks, and AWS ECS Fargate + Terraform IaC.
distributed-flash-sale-engine.line2: Sustains **10,000+ RPS** burst traffic with **0.00% overbooking**, **18.5 ms** p95 latency (93.2% lower than 271 ms `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`), and **0.00% HTTP 500** errors versus 18.4% relational pool exhaustion, paired with a Next.js 16 concurrency duel UI.

Bastion-hybrid-rag.title: Bastion — Zero-Leak Multi-Tenant Hybrid RAG Engine
Bastion-hybrid-rag.line1: Multi-tenant RAG platform executing pre-retrieval JWT `tenant_id` + `allowed_roles` SQL CTE filtering before `pgvector` HNSW + dual-FTS (`simple`/`english`) Reciprocal Rank Fusion, a `< 0.65` Cross-Encoder refusal gate (`0` LLM tokens on traps), and Redis 8 scoped semantic caching.
Bastion-hybrid-rag.line2: Benchmarked at **100.0% retrieval precision** and **1.0000 MRR** (+32.59% lift) across 28 probes, **0.0% ungrounded answers** and **0/14** RBAC/tenant leaks on adversarial traps, Ragas v0.4 evaluation, and a Next.js 16 landing + live `/workspace` SSE inspector.

PayGuard-AI-Agentic-Payment-Triage-RAG-E.title: PayGuard AI — Agentic Payment Dispute Triage & Regulatory RAG Engine
PayGuard-AI-Agentic-Payment-Triage-RAG-E.line1: Autonomous payment triage platform (`27.8k+` non-blank LOC, 18 API routes, 6 Alembic migrations) combining a strictly read-only 5-tool `ToolRegistry`, gateway-timeout non-mutation semantics, and prompt-injection defense with hybrid `pgvector` + FTS RAG over Visa/Mastercard/NACHA rules.
PayGuard-AI-Agentic-Payment-Triage-RAG-E.line2: Includes **207 test cases** across 20 modules (**181/181** independently audited pass), **40/40 (100%)** Ollama RAG evaluation (`100%` Recall@5, `1.0000` MRR, `100%` tenant isolation), **8/8** Playwright E2E tests, Docker staging `pg_dump`/`pg_restore` verification, and CI.

Glamgo.title: GlamGo — Beauty Retail Marketplace & Instant Booking Platform
Glamgo.line1: Production-deployed multi-vendor commerce and salon/at-home booking platform with integer-paise largest-remainder order splitting, row-locked `SellerListing` stock reservations, Razorpay HMAC-SHA256 webhook reconciliation, T+7 seller escrow, HTTP 409 double-booking guards, and immutable DB audit triggers.
Glamgo.line2: Verified with **78/78** local pytest tests against PostgreSQL 16 + Redis 7 (**62/62** in 3-stage GitHub Actions CI), **7.3x** faster warm catalog endpoints (`0.30s`), Playwright desktop/mobile E2E checks (`0` errors, `0px` overflow), and live Vercel + Render deployments.

ric0fc.title: RicozViz — Enterprise BI & Analytical Exploration Platform
ric0fc.line1: Dual-storage SaaS BI platform pairing DuckDB for sub-second analytical file queries with PostgreSQL for multi-tenant transactional metadata, strict server-side RBAC, schema-allowlisted query generation, and 192-bit cryptographic dashboard share tokens.
ric0fc.line2: Verified with **42/42** security audit tests, **13/13** static architectural checks, **10/10** Playwright security tests, **12/12** E2E pages with zero console/network errors, and live Vercel + Render/Supabase deployment configuration.

StockPulse-Multi-Tenant-Inventory-Order-.title: StockPulse — Multi-Tenant Inventory & POS Order Engine
StockPulse-Multi-Tenant-Inventory-Order-.line1: B2B multi-tenant inventory and POS order engine eliminating PostgreSQL `40P01` deadlocks via deterministic `ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE` lock ordering, `stock_quantity >= 0` check constraints, Indian GST bifurcation, and a Three.js 3D warehouse telemetry console.
StockPulse-Multi-Tenant-Inventory-Order-.line2: Verified with automated 10-thread parallel stress tests (`0` negative-stock drift), GitHub Actions CI with ephemeral PostgreSQL migrations, and an AST accessibility audit certifying **100% WCAG 2.1 AA** compliance across 19 UI components.

Real-Time-Commerce-and-Web-Application-P.title: OrderFlow — Multi-Restaurant Commerce & Real-Time Fulfillment Engine
Real-Time-Commerce-and-Web-Application-P.line1: Multi-restaurant ordering and kitchen fulfillment platform enforcing database-authoritative billing transactions, SHA-256 step-up 2FA OTP with atomic 3-attempt burn, and room-scoped Socket.io updates (`order:<id>`, `restaurant:<id>`).
Real-Time-Commerce-and-Web-Application-P.line2: Backed by an automated GitHub Actions CI pipeline running Prisma schema migrations on PostgreSQL 15, strict TypeScript checks, and Vitest + Supertest security tests.

Medicine-Link.title: MedicineLink — Surplus Medicine Redistribution Platform
Medicine-Link.line1: Academic healthcare redistribution prototype pairing Tesseract.js OCR + Sharp blister-pack intake with a 12-factor clinical eligibility engine, Haversine proximity matching, cryptographic QR tracking, and native SQLite WAL persistence.
Medicine-Link.line2: Built with full-stack TypeScript across 15 relational tables with partial unique first-accept concurrency guards (`ux_matches_one_accepted`), immutable audit triggers, Swagger OpenAPI docs, and passing Vitest suites.
